text:
Maya K: Quick heads up — noticed a regression after the 2/14 CUDA driver bump. Short prompts (<=32 tokens) TTFT p50 jumped ~18% and there's a visible extra kernel handoff in the waterfall.

Ben R: Ugh. Seen it too. Correlates with increased microkernel switches on matmul-heavy models.

Carla S: Can you paste the flamegraph or a sample trace? wondering if it's a scheduling gap or KV cache miss storm.

Maya K: Sample trace: ```
# extract from perfprobe
0.000s prequeue
0.004s kernel(matmul) on GPU0
0.006s context-switch
0.009s kernel(attention)
0.011s decode
``` 
There's a recurring 2-3ms context-switch between matmul->attention.

perf-bot: Deploy log: driver-update-2026-02-14 rolled to fleet at 04:12 UTC. No rollback events.

Leo (SRE): Could be the driver's preemption behavior. Any changes to batcher handshake timing? softbatch timer tweaks were applied last week.

Ana P: I rolled back the softbatch patch in staging earlier today — regression reproduced locally with the driver + softbatch enabled. With softbatch off, the extra gap disappears.

Ben R: That suggests an interaction: driver causes longer kernel tear-down when softbatch consolidates kernels. We need to instrument kernel handoffs and wait-sleep counts.

Jordan (R&D): I'll add a lightweight event around kernel submit/complete. Proposal for probe fields: `kernel_name`, `queue_latency_us`, `handoff_type` (direct|context-switch), `batch_size`, `kv_hit`.

Maya K: +1. Also add per-route prefix-hit ratio so we can correlate TTFT vs KV cache behavior in the dashboard. Current dashboard only has aggregate hits.

Carla S: For dashboards: suggest a waterfall panel showing per-token stages with stacked bars (prequeue -> kernel_queue -> kernel_exec -> decode). P95 and p99 toggles.

Ben R: I'll open a short-lived dashboard and add correlation scatterplots: `kv_prefix_hit` vs `token_ttft_delta`. If we see clusters for short prompts it confirms hypothesis.

Maya K: Thanks all. Action items: Jordan to add probe (ETA 4h), Ben to build dashboard (ETA EOD), Ana to test rollback matrices across driver versions. Continue thread with results. :mag:
